'''Gray Three''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by the third [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of Gray Squadron or Gray Flight. Both [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] used these designations, and several individuals used the call sign Gray Three.

==History==
Approximately [[0 ABY/Legends|two months after]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="SW1">[[Star Wars (2013) 1|''Star Wars'' (2013) 1]]</ref> [[Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] covert [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], [[Stealth Squadron|Gray Flight]], used the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] Gray Three to refer to both the two-person [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] of [[Gram Cortess]] and [[Ardana Cinn]], and [[Tess Alder]] as an individual.<ref name="SW4" />

At the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ekelarc Yong/Legends|Ekelarc Yong]] was designated Gray Three, flying a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] with [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R5-P9]]<ref name="Hasbro" /> as part of [[Gray Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gray Squadron]].<ref name="CCGGSP" />

[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] pilot [[Falynn Sandskimmer]] was the third member of [[Wraith Squadron|Gray Squadron]] prior to its adoption of its permanent designation, Wraith Squadron. Fellow Wraith Lieutenant [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] would use the same call sign during the squadron's time posing as the crew of the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']], which was aligned with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. Flying its complement of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], the Wraiths adopted the designation of [[Gray Flight (New Republic)|Gray Flight]]. Janson participated in the [[Battle of Ession]] as Gray Three.<ref name="XWWS" />
